messages:
jena (CS): quick async standup — short notes (what I did / blockers / today)
jena (CS): yesterday: dug into Kestrel webhook retries with customer, reproduced 503s for payloads >~256KB and intermittent 502s. collected sample request ids and a failing curl.
matt (Eng): thanks jena. can you paste the failing request id + endpoint?
jena (CS): req id 8f3c2a7b; endpoint /v1/webhooks/events. sample curl i gave them:
```bash
curl -v -X POST 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/webhooks/events' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -H 'X-Customer-Tenant: kestrel-42' \\n  --data-binary @large_payload.json
```
jana (note: accidental name)
tariq (SRE): saw similar pattern last week when a sidecar timed out and kube restarted the pod — resulted in 502s for in-flight streaming. can you grab the pod logs: `kubectl logs -l app=kestrel-webhook -n customer-prod --since=1h` and grep the req id?
jena (CS): pasted minimal logs from their support bundle below (sanitized):
[2026-03-17T16:24:12Z] INFO request=8f3c2a7b started conn=10.1.5.12
[2026-03-17T16:24:14Z] ERROR request=8f3c2a7b write failed: connection reset by peer
[2026-03-17T16:24:14Z] WARN request=8f3c2a7b responded 503 in 2300ms
matt (Eng): likely inflight queue + sidecar limit. quick mitigation ideas: 1) drop concurrent inflight for that tenant/route, 2) enable smaller chunking on payloads, 3) route them to a dedicated pool if they need sustained throughput.
matt (Eng): i'll open a tiny PR to lower `max_inflight` for that route and add a temporary rule to route kestrel-42 to the dedicated pool if available — will pin the change behind a rollout flag.
matt (Eng): PR: github.com/redwood/infr/infra-config/pull/4321 (link) — @jena can you add the tenant id and paste a short repro in the PR?
jena (CS): on it. blocker for the dedicated pool option: legal needs to sign the dedicated capacity addendum before we can provision for them. sales says the contract may land by EOD.
sophia (PM): noted — i'll nudge sales/legal. scheduled renewal call at 15:00 PT today, jena will join.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy for `routing/v2` completed — health checks passed :white_check_mark:
matt (Eng): nice. small heads-up — i'm queued to review CR-8232 (code review for the routing change) after this thread. main change is default `smart_routing.fallback = "regional"` and a small guard for oversized webhook payloads.
matt (Eng): excerpt of config i plan to apply as emergency mitigation (low-risk):
```yaml
routes:
  - name: webhook-events
    match: /v1/webhooks/events
    max_inflight: 10
    routing_hint: dedicated_if_tenant:kestrel-42
```
tariq (SRE): for immediate debugging you can temporarily set `retry-after: 0` on the proxy to avoid requeue storms, and collect `sidecar_restart_count` metrics. I'll watch the pod eviction metrics.
jena (CS): thanks — i'll push the logs and the sample payload into the PR and leave a comment once legal updates me.
matt (Eng): if legal misses EOD, i'll apply the `max_inflight: 10` change behind a canary for 10% traffic to kestrel-42 so we at least reduce failures while we wait.
sophia (PM): please note any customer-visible changes in the renewal thread so CS can mention it in the 3pm call.
jena (CS): will do. today i'll: 1) keep collecting failing req ids, 2) join 3pm renewal, 3) post contract update. blocker: waiting on legal sign-off and on ENG to merge small mitigation (matt).
matt (Eng): i'll try to review + merge before the renewal call. if not, i'll at least submit the canary and notify ops.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout for `routing/v2` -> 10% for kestrel-42 at 1768130000
jena (CS): thanks all — tagging CS leads for visibility :thumbsup: (no action required now)
sophia (PM): thanks team. any quick asks from eng?
matt (Eng): none beyond the PR review.
jena (CS): that's all from me. closing this thread for now, will update when legal or PR arrive.
